india.one_line: India sees new multilingual speech model, AI software partnership, and industrial AI lab launch.

themes.title: Chariot releases multilingual speech model
themes.text: Chariot introduced Chariot‑1‑ASR Realtime, a speech‑to‑text system covering ten Indian languages and Indian English, reporting lower error rates across 79 public test sets.

stories.headline: Chariot launches real‑time speech model for 10 Indian languages

themes.title: Tech Mahindra teams with SpaceXSI
themes.text: Tech Mahindra announced a partnership with AI coding platform SpaceXSI to provide AI‑assisted software engineering services aimed at modernising legacy applications and improving developer productivity for global enterprises.

stories.headline: Tech Mahindra partners with SpaceXSI to boost AI‑assisted software engineering

themes.title: LTM opens industrial AI lab
themes.text: LTM inaugurated the BlueVerse Industrial AI Lab in Chennai, offering clients and partners a space to develop, simulate and validate AI solutions for industrial operations before deployment.

stories.headline: LTM launches BlueVerse Industrial AI Lab in Chennai
